name: Sony BRAVIA XR-65A80J
summary: Sony BRAVIA XR-65A80J OLED ships with a viewing tracker, home screen promos and hotel-mode apps. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with undo.
intro: This Sony OLED ships with Samba TV, which tracks what is on screen, plus Qterics and Sony agents that report device and usage data. The Google TV home carries a Sony promo tile and content rows, and partner apps can install themselves. The TV also has retail demo mode, hotel and pro-mode services, and help tiles.

The list was checked on this TV and tested with a replacement launcher. TidyTV turns these apps off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything, so each one can be switched back on in the app.
keep: Live TV, tuner and the Sony input app
BRAVIA Sync, HDMI-CEC and eARC audio services
The Play Store and Play Services
notes: Do not turn off the stock home until a working replacement is installed and checked.
AirPlay, DLNA and the broadcast red-button player (HbbTV) are optional choices on the list.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my Sony XR-65A80J?
faq.a: Yes. The voice assistant is kept.
Yes for Chromecast and Miracast, which are kept. AirPlay is an optional switch on the list.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything in the app turns every app back on and puts the stock Google TV home screen back.
